agentPage.title: Agents
agentPage.intro: Your organization has four built-in agents. Each one specializes in your business, and you can turn it on, pause it and customize it.
agentPage.emptyDescription: Here you will see its conversation, what it has done and what it has pending. It arrives with the agent catalog: instructions, skills, channels and autonomy.

descriptions.reception: Scheduling: creates, moves and cancels appointments, manages the waiting list and reminders, organizes resources and rooms, and answers the business phone line.
descriptions.customer: Serves your customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, email and the web: answers questions and issues, handles reviews and hands over to a person when needed.
descriptions.sales: Captures and qualifies leads, keeps the CRM, prepares quotes, follows up, wins back customers and runs the campaigns the coach proposes.
descriptions.admin: Invoicing through your own software, collections, expenses, inventory and suppliers, documents and the information your accountant needs.
